data.title: Financial Data Analyst
data.fitReason: Perfect alignment with 6 years of accounting expertise combined with newly acquired SQL, Python, and Power BI skills. Candidate understands financial workflows, compliance requirements, and business metrics—critical for financial reporting roles. Advanced Excel proficiency directly applicable.

data.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
data.fitReason: Demonstrated ability to build 2 Power BI dashboards end-to-end with business problem understanding from accounting background. SQL and Python skills enable data pipeline work. Financial domain knowledge reduces learning curve for business context interpretation.

data.title: Accounting Systems Analyst
data.fitReason: Leverages 6 years of accounting expertise to analyze and optimize financial systems and workflows. Technical skills in SQL and Python enable system data extraction and automation tasks. Excel proficiency supports reconciliation and reporting automation.

data.title: Financial Reporting Analyst
data.fitReason: Core background in financial reporting with 6 years of direct experience. New technical skills in Power BI and SQL enable automation and visualization of existing reporting workflows. Can bridge manual processes with automated solutions.

data.title: Data Analyst (Finance/Accounting)
data.fitReason: Explicit market positioning as junior data analyst with dual strength in financial domain and emerging technical capabilities. SQL and Python cover basic data extraction and transformation. Power BI dashboard experience demonstrates output capability.

data.title: Compliance and Audit Analyst
data.fitReason: 6 years of accounting experience with reconciliation expertise directly applicable to compliance and audit workflows. SQL skills enable data extraction for audit procedures. Python and Power BI support analytical testing and reporting automation.

data.title: Junior SQL Developer (Data-Focused)
data.fitReason: Basic SQL and Python skills meet junior developer expectations. Financial domain knowledge provides context for understanding data models in finance/accounting systems. Excel power-user background suggests strong logic and data manipulation aptitude.

data.title: Analytics Engineer (Entry-Level)
data.fitReason: Completed analytics certificate and built end-to-end Power BI dashboards showing pipeline thinking. SQL and Python skills are foundational for analytics engineering. Financial domain knowledge provides use-case clarity, though lacks production data infrastructure experience.

data.title: Excel Analyst / Financial Modeler
data.fitReason: Explicitly noted as Excel power user with 6 years of financial analysis experience and advanced proficiency in complex modeling, pivot tables, and conditional logic. Can handle complex financial models with SQL/Python supplementary skills.

data.title: Cost Analyst
data.fitReason: 6 years of accounting background enables understanding of cost structures and financial analysis. New SQL and Python skills support data extraction from accounting systems. Power BI supports cost reporting automation and visualization.
